mentions.name: Read-Only Social Media Access
mentions.description: This tool provides read-only access to social media content without requiring an account, exposing content via HTML and RSS/Atom feeds, with possible ActivityPub support planned. A proof of concept is expected in a few weeks.
mentions.problem: Accessing social media content normally requires having an account.
mentions.source_excerpt: A way to access social media content read only without an account, with HTML, RSS/Atom and at some point ActivityPub probably. I will probably post here in a few weeks when PoC will up.

evidence.value: A way to access social media content read only without an account, with HTML, RSS/Atom and at some point ActivityPub probably. I will probably post here in a few weeks when PoC will up.
